  • International moves: Russia, China, India cleared to use Hormuz by Iran. Kuwait plans crude production increase (market impact potential).
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF reported a successful strike on a Hezbollah tunnel target; Pakistan mediation and the temporary pause create a diplomatic window.
